title: Ask and Assess: Get App and MCP Server Risk Intelligence in Chat
summary: Across the globe, organizations have rushed to incorporate AI into workflows. Netskope Threat Labs’ 2026 AI Report shows more than 95% of organizations
body_markdown:
Across the globe, organizations have rushed to incorporate AI into workflows. Netskope Threat Labs’


[2026 AI Report](https://www.netskope.com/resources/threat-labs-reports/netskope-ai-report-2026) shows more than 95% of organizations now use AI chatbots and 92% use AI platforms. In a ten week period between April and June 2026, MCP transactions increased 375%.


In the face of this rapid adoption, security teams must assess the risk of every new application or MCP server before approving its deployment – and the volume of these assessments continues to rise. Manual searches, query syntax, and advanced filters all add delays to the process, and are heavily dependent on a small group of senior analysts.


Put simply, the growth in AI applications and MCP servers is increasing the volume of risk assessments and consuming valuable analyst time. AI can help by handling much of the research and information gathering, giving analysts faster access to the intelligence they need to make decisions.


## Assess risk intelligence in one conversation


Netskope CCI Insights Agent solves this challenge by turning application and MCP research into a conversation, not a trawl through multiple databases, files and documentation dumps. Ideally, the analysts have access to instant answers that make risk intelligence easier to access, process and deliver.


Part of Netskope One AgentSkope, Netskope’s agentic operations platform for security workflows, Netskope CCI Insights Agent is built into the Netskope App Catalog already available to all Netskope customers. The agent retrieves information from more than 86,000 cloud, firewall, and AI applications and more than 1,100 Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. It also enriches responses with relevant public information and can examine additional sources when more context is needed.


## Ask, resolve, refine


First, the agent lowers barriers to security intelligence. Analysts can use natural language to question the App Catalog without relying on specialized query skills or detailed knowledge of catalog structures. More analysts can query the App Catalog, so approvals no longer depend entirely on the few people who know the syntax. Questions can be about one application or MCP server, or about the catalog as a whole. No matter the type and length of a query, the path from question to insight becomes shorter. For example, an analyst can ask, “Does Box support single sign-on SSO?” or “Give me a list of applications in the AI category.”


Second, the agent transforms application intelligence into decision-ready context. It detects intent and verifies that the user’s question falls safely within its scope. If not, it will ask the user to rephrase the question, and mention that it can’t answer it. The agent then combines App Catalog data and when needed with public source research to produce structured, evidence-based answers within the analyst workflow. Questions about individual applications receive direct answers, and broader investigations include ranked and exportable datasets enriched with Netskope Cloud Confidence Index (CCI) and Netskope Cloud Confidence Level (CCL) scores.


Third, the agent aligns with how analysts conduct risk assessments. Analysts build conclusions through a series of investigative steps that add context and evidence. They refine scope, compare alternatives, validate assumptions, and investigate exceptions before making a recommendation. Netskope CCI Insights Agent supports this process. It retains context across interactions so analysts can extend previous findings, refine results, and investigate follow-up questions within the same conversation. Each interaction adds to the assessment, helping analysts develop supported conclusions without repeatedly reconstructing the investigative trail.


## Quick answers, faster decisions


The value of risk intelligence is dependent on security teams getting hold of it quickly enough to act on it. Netskope CCI Insights Agent helps close the gap between a question and a decision, reducing the effort required to move from assessment to policy, approval, or governance action.


Analysts can retrieve evidence through a single conversation instead of conducting manual research across App Catalog records, filters, and public sources. The end result is, more efficient assessment of new AI applications, reviews of existing deployments, and improved policy refinement.


Compliance reviews, governance discussions, audits, and risk assessments all move faster because routine fact-checking gets completed in minutes. Security teams can apply governance standards more consistently, support a higher volume of reviews, and respond to business requests faster.


## The next step


Organizations can deploy the agent through the AgentSkope Marketplace, the agentic operations platform within Netskope One, where analysts can manage and track AgentSkope agents through a shared pool of capacity credits.


Download the datasheet and watch the demo to learn how Netskope CCI Insights Agent can help accelerate AI approvals, risk assessments, and policy decisions in your environment.
